However, using Python package R comes downsides terms : - performance, since data needs copied across languages / sessions - flexibility, since reticulate makes opinionated choices work box use cases - robustness, since packages depending reticulate need risk breaking changes python packages now depend , need provide environment via {basilisk}. grumpy, hand, pure R package dependency performant, flexible.
